# Vendor

Third-party files copied as-is (no CDN, no npm install).

| File | What | Version |
|---|---|---|
| `supabase.js` | `@supabase/supabase-js` v2, UMD build (`dist/umd/supabase.js`) | pinned, see header of the file |

Only needed when `CONFIG.MODE = 'supabase'`. In demo mode it is never loaded.
How to get it: see `docs/CONFIGURATION.md`, step "supabase-js".
